"""Repro for ticket #31728: DatabaseCache._cull TypeError when culling query returns no row.

CULL_FREQUENCY=1 makes cull_num == num, so 'LIMIT 1 OFFSET num' returns no row
-> cursor.fetchone() is None -> old code crashed with TypeError on [0].
"""
import os
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
                           'NAME': 'C:/Windows/Temp/cull_repro.sqlite3'}},
    CACHES={'default': {'BACKEND': 'django.core.cache.backends.db.DatabaseCache',
                        'LOCATION': 'cull_repro_table',
                        'OPTIONS': {'MAX_ENTRIES': 1, 'CULL_FREQUENCY': 1}}},
    USE_TZ=False,
    INSTALLED_APPS=[],
)
django.setup()

if os.path.exists('C:/Windows/Temp/cull_repro.sqlite3'):
    os.remove('C:/Windows/Temp/cull_repro.sqlite3')

from django.core.management import call_command  # noqa: E402
call_command('createcachetable', verbosity=0)

from django.core.cache import cache  # noqa: E402
for i in range(5):
    cache.set('key%d' % i, 'value%d' % i)
print('OK: 5 sets with culling triggered, no TypeError')
